name: @rvboris/opencode-mempalace
description: OpenCode plugin for hidden MemPalace retrieval and autosave via a local Python adapter.

scripts.lint: biome lint plugin tests scripts package.json tsconfig.json example-opencode.json biome.json
scripts.lint:ci: biome lint plugin tests scripts package.json tsconfig.json example-opencode.json biome.json
scripts.test: bun run build && bun test --parallel ./tests/*.test.ts && bun test --conditions=browser --preload @opentui/solid/preload tests/v2-hud.test.tsx && bun test --conditions=browser tests/v2-hud-built.test.tsx
scripts.test:coverage: bun run build && bun test --parallel ./tests/*.test.ts --coverage --coverage-reporter=text --coverage-reporter=lcov && bun test --conditions=browser --preload @opentui/solid/preload tests/v2-hud.test.tsx && bun test --conditions=browser tests/v2-hud-built.test.tsx
